Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Terms and Conditions for Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) of Printers 1. Scope of Work

The successful bidder shall provide comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) services for printer s installed at the Department's office premises. The scope shall include preventive maintenance, breakdo wn maintenance, repair, servicing, troubleshooting and replacement of defective spare parts, wherever ap plicable, to ensure the printers remain in proper working condition throughout the contract period. 2. Contract Period The AMC shall initially be for a period of 12 months from the date of commencement of the contract. Extension of the contract, if required, shall be subject to satisfactory performance, mutual consent a nd approval of the Competent Authority, as per applicable procurement rules. The service provider shall commence the services from the date specified in the work order. 3. Comprehensive Maintenance The AMC shall be comprehensive and shall cover all necessary service, labour, repairs and replace ment of defective parts. The cost of spare parts, consumables and other components shall be borne by the service provider, wherever included in the comprehensive AMC. No additional charges shall be payable by the Department for services covered under the contract. The service provider shall ensure that only genuine and compatible spare parts are used. 4. Preventive Maintenance The service provider shall carry out preventive maintenance at least once every three months or as and when required by the Department. Preventive maintenance shall include cleaning, inspection, testing, adjustment and servicing of print ers. A service report shall be submitted to the Department after each preventive maintenance visit. 5. Breakdown Maintenance and Response Time The service provider shall attend complaints within 24 hours of receiving the complaint. The printer shall be repaired and restored to working condition within 48 hours of the complaint, wh erever practicable. In case the printer cannot be repaired at the office premises, the service provider shall arrange its r epair at its service centre at no additional cost, including transportation. In case of delay, the service provider shall inform the Department of the reasons and expected repai r time.
